title: Quantitative Trader Intern 2027
description:
IMC is a fast, dynamic environment where you’re trusted to make decisions from day one. We trade a wide range of financial instruments in many different ways. This means we look for different types of traders, from the quantitative minds who enjoy the mathematical side of trading to those who want more of the fast-paced, hands-on style of trading and have a higher appetite for risk.
Our quantitative traders all share one thing in common — they are at their best when solving complex problems. Their insights into global events, market shifts, and pricing ensure that we always trade in the right place, at the right time.
Our 10-week trading internship is your chance to experience life as a trader at IMC. You’ll have all the support you need to succeed: a mixture of hands-on and classroom training and a mentor overseeing your work and professional development. Where you go from here is up to you — the majority of our interns secure a graduate position at the end of the programme.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
From day one, you are immersed in real projects, complex problem-solving, and opportunities to learn from some of the industry’s strongest Traders and Engineers.
See what it is like to be a Quantitative Trader at IMC; develop your trading skills and systematic trading strategies.
Work collaboratively in an environment where creativity, teamwork, and innovation are recognised and rewarded.
Be supported by a mentor who will oversee your progress and professional development.
Have the opportunity to secure a full-time role with IMC once you graduate.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 
An academic background in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Studies, Finance, or Economics, with a minimum Distinction average or equivalent.
Commenced your penultimate year of study.
Strong analytical skills and a desire to solve complicated problems.
The ability to make decisions under uncertainty and remain focused under pressure.
A genuine passion for financial markets (no prior knowledge or experience is required).
The ability to commence in May/June 2027.
About Us
IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.
